speaker: voicedata-candidate-b
prosody_source: Voice B training-set mean of foundation-normalized prosody features

serving.selection_score: speaker_similarity - 1.0 * cer - 0.05 * F0-envelope penalty - 0.05 * timbre penalty

notes: Adds the timbre gate to recipe v4. Motivation: CMOS session v1 (2026-08-09) failed promotion with same-person 0/12 on synth-vs-real pairs while verifier similarity read 0.91+; the listener localized the mismatch to voice tone alone. Band-spectrum analysis confirmed a +4.0 dB presence-band (4.7-6.8 kHz) excess and formant-region tilt versus real recordings, generated by the acoustic model (vocoder reconstruction is transparent within 0.4 dB). Selection now subtracts 0.05 x timbre penalty (RMS z-score of the level-normalized 11-band spectrum shape against the Candidate real-voice profile, scripts/build-timbre-profile.py). Sweep on the frozen 8-seed candidate set: w=0.05 cut mean timbre penalty 2.585 -> 2.182 and switched 44/120 picks for +0.1pp CER; owner listening confirmed the new picks sound closer to the real voice. Known ceiling: selection floor (~1.8-2.2) remains above the real-voice range [0.47, 0.98]; closing the rest is the Antalia 1.1 consistency-retune target (train-time tripwire: timbre penalty of held-out synthesis must enter the real range before CMOS v2).
